title: Jsontron 0.1
description: Jsontron vocabulary: Schematron-like rules, assert, report, and let keywords over JSON Schema, using jq expressions.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: test and message source are this jq expression.

let.description: Object mapping variable names (matching [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*, excluding the reserved 'root') to jq expressions. Entries are evaluated in document order; each takes the first value of its expression (or null if the stream is empty).

rules.description: Array of rules. Each rule selects context nodes with a jq expression and runs asserts and/or reports.

context.description: jq expression evaluated against the current instance; each result is a context node.

asserts.description: Assertions that FAIL when the test is not jq-truthy (classic Schematron assert).

reports.description: Assertions that FAIL when the test IS jq-truthy (classic Schematron report).

assert.description: Sugar for a rule with context ".". String, object, or array of those; all append to one context="." rule. Fails when the test is not jq-truthy.

report.description: Sugar for a rule with context "." whose test polarity is inverted (Schematron report). Fails when the test IS jq-truthy.

let.description: Schema-level let bindings in scope for every rule at this schema location, alongside $root.
